responsibility: Implements the Rust frontend’s small bridge to GCC’s garbage-collected identifier intern pool. This file defines the out-of-line behavior of Rust::GGC::Ident constructors and string comparison by creating or probing GCC identifier_node trees through get_identifier, get_identifier_with_length, and maybe_get_identifier, so Rust utility and frontend code can canonicalize names onto GCC’s shared stringpool representation and compare them by interned tree identity rather than by owned std::string storage.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file for the rust-ggc pair: unlike rust-ggc.h, it provides the out-of-line constructor and std::string comparison definitions that call GCC stringpool APIs such as get_identifier, get_identifier_with_length, and maybe_get_identifier to create/probe identifier_node instances.
